info.name: Emarsys Core API - Media Database endpoint batch

params.name: folder
params.description: The folder identifier. If provided, only subfolders of the specified folder are listed.

items.docs:
Returns a list of all folders in the Media Database.

**Tip**: Use the `folder` query parameter to only list subfolders of a specific folder.
Creates a new folder in a specified existing parent folder in the Media Database.
Returns the properties of a media file in the Media Database.

params.name: folder
params.description: The folder identifier. If provided, only files in the specified folder are listed.

items.docs:
Returns a list of all media files in the Media Database.

**Tip:** Use the `folder` query parameter to only list files in a specific folder.

info.name: Upload a File into the Media Database

items.docs: Uploads a file to the Media Database in Base64 encoding. **Notes** - File names are case sensitive. - The upload limit is 16 MB for images, 100 MB for documents and 4 MB for other file formats. - Refer to uploaded files in email campaigns in the following format: ``` ```
Removes a media file from the Media Database.
